options.name: capacity
options.description: Size of the volume to be created, as a scaled integer (see NOTES in `man virsh`), defaulting to size of backing volume and defaulting to bytes if there is no suffix. Required if C(state) is C(present).

options.name: format
options.description: Used in file based storage pools to specify the volume file format to use; raw, bochs, qcow, qcow2, vmdk, qed. Use extended for disk storage pools in order to create an extended partition (other values are validity checked but not preserved when libvirtd is restarted or the pool is refreshed).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the new volume. For a disk pool, this must match the partition name as determined from the pool's source device path and the next available partition. For example, a source device path of /dev/sdb and there are no partitions on the disk, then the name must be sdb1 with the next name being sdb2 and so on.

options.name: pool
options.description: Name or UUID of the storage pool to create the volume in.

options.name: prealloc_metadata
options.description: Preallocate metadata (for qcow2 images which don't support full allocation). This option creates a sparse image file with metadata, resulting in higher performance compared to images with no preallocation and only slightly higher initial disk space usage.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the volume be present or absent.
